clauses.text:
SCHEDULE
B y virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of title 5 of  
the United States Code, as amended, Executive Order No. 112481  of  
October 10,1965, as amended, is further amended as follow s:

1. Section 1 of that Order, placing certain positions in level I Y  of  
the Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text:
(a) by deleting “ (3) Special Assistant to the Secretary (Food-For-  
Peace Program), State Department”, and inserting in lieu thereof  
“ (3) Administrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, Department of  
Health, Education, and W elfare” ;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) by deleting u (4) Executive Secretary, President’s Commission  
on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice”, and inserting in  
lieu thereof “ (4) Administrator, National Institutes of Health, De­
partment of Health, Education, and W elfare” ; and

(8) Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administra­
tion, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare.
(9) Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability.

2. Section 2 of that Order, placing certain positions in level Y  of the  
Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by deleting “ (15) A d ­
ministrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, Department of Health,  
Education, and W elfare”, and inserting in lieu thereof “ (15) Deputy  
Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administration,  
Department of Health, Education, and W elfare.”

THE PRESIDENT 6601
Executive Order 11409
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. T1248, PLACING CERTAIN POSI­
TIONS IN LEVELS IV AND V OF THE FEDERAL EXECUTIVE SALARY
SCHEDULE
B y virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5317 of title 5 of  
the United States Code, as amended, Executive Order No. 112481  of  
October 10,1965, as amended, is further amended as follow s:
1. Section 1 of that Order, placing certain positions in level I Y  of  
the Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended:
(a) by deleting “ (3) Special Assistant to the Secretary (Food-For-  
Peace Program), State Department”, and inserting in lieu thereof  
“ (3) Administrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, Department of  
Health, Education, and W elfare” ;
(b) by deleting u (4) Executive Secretary, President’s Commission  
on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice”, and inserting in  
lieu thereof “ (4) Administrator, National Institutes of Health, De­
partment of Health, Education, and W elfare” ; and
(c) by adding thereto the following:
(8) Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administra­
tion, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare.
(9) Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability.
2. Section 2 of that Order, placing certain positions in level Y  of the  
Federal Executive Salary Schedule, is amended by deleting “ (15) A d ­
ministrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, Department of Health,  
Education, and W elfare”, and inserting in lieu thereof “ (15) Deputy  
Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administration,  
Department of Health, Education, and W elfare.”
T h e W h it e H ouse ,
A p r il 29, 1968.
[F.R. Doc. 68-5313; Filed, Apr. 30, 1968 ; 9:42 a.m.]
